translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yuddas sok wanesa sung uta ko.
Kale kutim midiliw kal bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim adikum keidiw, Yu kayak gebom gebom keidiw tada tada aket tet dau weng bako nadiwade Yesus ayo anbiduw fikalako, kalbiwe,
afan teng sok aluk gei daw tamo dew yak nadiwade Udom gawman kin mo be Bailet dádawsiw ko.

Kale Yuddas Yesus gi dauyamsa kinim ayo atamane, Yesus ayo daw mafak dádi ka. Kale nadale beso kuw kanamom ban keidi kuwe kalbane, aka asiki kisol tem kadel 30 kal uyo kutam moda ki kudew yak bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim so gebom gebom so kuyama.
Kale aka bakoda, “naka ban kei nadile, kinim ban keimin banim beta gi dauyami ka.” Yakane, ika weng kala bakodaw, “be num san bá, be kalam san ka.” Akiwe,
bude Yuddas ayo tum tem kadel uyo dibinoyama tam Yol am abune kudá nadale yak sok wanesa.
Kale bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim iyo dák tumon uyo kudu nadiwade bakodiw, “belayo ki kaim sánin kisol kayo dew maek Yol am kisol so dokuyamin bá, be num abem ko.
Kale nadiwade weng kidela ku nadiwe kaim sánin kisol uyo kudu kudew yak bakan but mak mosiw. Kale bakan be tawal kudu ket kidelin báno, ika fitad tademin imi fom kuámin bán keiduko, kale mosiw ko.
Kale be kanosiw kayo bakan be win takudaw Kaim Fukadása Bakan kalesiw ade kamane so bakan bewák Kaim Fukadása Bakan kalbiw ko.

Kale lum senin kinim Yedimaya suwayo kal kanodokabuno kale weng bakosa namti, matam dam abudu ka. Kale aka be kanam kalesa. “Isadael kayak iyo tem kadel 30 kal be kudu nadiwe kinim ami kun fakusiw ade kisol be kudu nadiwade
tawal ket kidelin bakan mosiw. Kale be Kamok alata kanoyo nakeisa.” Kalesa ko.
Yesus Bailet dim weng bakamsa umi sung uta ko.
Kale Yesus ayo tam gawman kin mobe kinim dim todane, aka Yesus dákadálawa. “Kaba Yu kayak Kamoke?” Akane, Yesus asik weng anung kala bakodaw, “au, kalbaw be ki ka.” Akane,
bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim so gebom gebom so ika kanada bom weng mafak bakadawsiw. Kata imi kanam bakadabiw weng be mak akal yán kisa bá.
Kale beta Bailet asik dákadálaw, “kaba imi weng mafak bakakabiw bo kidiyam badaw bade bá?” Aka.
Kata Yesus ayo Bailet weng bakaba weng atung uyo atin katiw so mak fakadu bakodawongin banim, kayo gawman kamok ayo kin antam dá beso kuwo kalsa ko.
Kale be gawman kin modin kinim alam kukuw kanamino, kale bada bi ban imin wanin atan keida ka. Kale som abiw kasel ilita kinim mak sok gei tabesiw iyo makuwe walu dau sidiw talá dabadá dabadá álano.
Kale kanabiw am dána be ayo kinim kukuw mafak seng fakudin kinim mak kinim adik kal keisiw be sok gei daudiw kalabus am be. Kale ami win ayo Badábas.
Kale kinim wanang seng adik tada tada gei daudiwe, Bailet ayo dákadáyam, “kinim ayo kan ata sok talá dauyamokabi, Badábas ata bade Yesus Got Walusa Kinim akbiw atane?” Yakane,
Bailet ayo atin alam kal keidomane, ika Yesus win dukum kei be ayo titidaw nadiwo dew tad dánamiw ka,

kal bom nadane aka kot keimin bán dim kano tein alayo alam kadel uyo weng mak kudálu tadu uyo bako nadule, “kaba kinim ami ban keimin banim kayo yaknodawon so kalin bá. Naka kamano ami lum mak bo nadi kun banbin so keinam be kala.” Kalu.

Kata bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim so gebom gebom so iyo wanang kinim seng seng im aket dakfáya bom nadiwe Bailet dákadálaw, “ken Badábas ata sok talá dauyam nadawe Yesus ata anbidoluwako?” Kaliwe,
beta gawman kin mo be ayo dákadála, “kinim alew bidi yak ata kim aket sok talá dauyamokabine?” Yakane, ika weng kala bakodaw, “Badábas atano.” Akeisiw.
Alo beta Bailet ayo dákadáyam, “naka mew kinim Yesus Got Walusa Kinim akbiw, be yaknodawokabine? Kalane, wanang kinim iyo weng kala bakodaw, “anak as dim dádino!” Kaliwe,
Bailet aka dákadála, “watawo kaleyo? Mafak so mak keiseno kanam kalbiwe?” Kala, kata ika weng alaw kuw bako nadiwade, “anak as dim dadino!” Kaliwe,

Bailet ayo utamomane atin yakno idum uyo kidel kudomi banim keidu ka. Kale nadale kinim iyo itamomane ginongin aket ki yak falu ka. Kale aka yak wok kudu nadale wanang kinim kin dim kadákal teng wok fuwu nadale bako, “naka mew kinim belami ambidokabiw be nam san bá, kale be kibilim san adik dáw ka.” Yakeisa.
Adikum wanang kinim iyo bako nadiwade, “ami fikalokaba bo nulum san ade nulum muduw im san ka.”
Kaliwe, afan Badábas ayo sok talá dauyama, kata Yesus ata un tabudin dauyama faum si dau dew yak anak as dim dádino, kale dauyamsa ko.
Un tabudin tabe Yesus atafimsiw umi sung uta ko.
Kale Bailet gawman kin modin alam un tabudin iyo Yesus dew tam alam am abiw dal nadiwade kanomin un tabudin kinim iyo tada tada falala dau nadiwade
ika ilim gulkan keidaw nadiwade kamok keimin ilim kal kas kimis mak gei falala keidaw nadiwade

bude baing fakama daudom nadiwo win tabin manil kidel ku nadiwade kudew yak gebom kidis kudák tadelaw nadiwade kamok kitid keimin as gang kafulok taw mak kudew yak teng miskuno kuek tadelawiw fakudane, alam kin gubuyo kal ilim katun katun luko dudák di nadiwade atafi bom bakodiw, “kala, Yu kayak kamokim kaba.” Ak bom nadiwade
ika kasuk fadet yak sánla bom nadiwade yak as gang kudawiw fakuba uyo kukidaw alom nadiwo kudew yak gebom dakáda bom faumsiw.
Kale ika atafimin be banimane, ilim mikidawbiw uyo gulkan keidaw nadiwe alo alam lim uyo asiki mikidaw nadiwade beta aka dew yak as dim sil biki anbidumo, kale dew uniw ko.
Yesus as dim sil biki anbisiw sung uta ko.
Kale ika dew leiw unom nadiw kinim mak leiw eidawiw ami win ayo Saimon Saidin bakan kayak, kale ika fotabiw as dawing dákamin uyo kudawiw kudewa iso una.
Kale ika tadiw ki tad bi tad anang mukkun win Golgáta (mukkun kinim gebom kun taw uyo win takumam kinim gebom kun kalbiw,)
kal yak nadiwe kabadákal wain wok atud so kuok so uyo andakela ku nadiwe kudawiw, aka wane utam nadale wanokabi báno kale kudálane,
beta ika as dawing dákamin dim daw tam gi sil biki anbi nadiwade ika ami ilim ayo gele kusiw. Kata ika sung ginan bom nadiwo kan ata win keida, aka ilim mak kudula kudula keimsiw ko.
Ade dák tein bom nadiwade ika dafimobisiw.
Kale tam alam daw tam gibiw gebomo be atam liwin weng mak godu dok as kom dim dawti bako kalesiw be, YESUS BELA YU KAYAK KAMOK kale godusiw ko.
Kanabisiw ayo yakot wanin kinim alew mak Yesus wol bake sil biki im tam as dim gibiw. Kale mak be Yesus alam teng miskuno kal, mak be alam awáno kal kanodaw keisiw ko.
Kale wanang kinim iyo leiw tadene bom nadiwe weng kufo atam li bom bakada bom nadiwe gebom budu budu bom nadiwade
ika bakodiw, “kawta bako nadawo, ‘Yol am uyo dakel ku alo am alewbino kuw kei ginedokabi.’ Kalesadaw. Kale kalam kál bábu uyo takan keiyo, kala katamuwo kaba Got Man kayo as dim kudáyo.” Akansiw ko.
Alo weng alataw be ki bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim so sawa kukumin kinim so gebom gebom so iyo aban fakadá bom nadiwe

ika bakodiw, “aka yak madik ita kail bá takeikuyamába, kata alami kál bábu uta takeikudongin banim. Ade aka afan Yu kayak imi Kamokime? Aka afan as dim uyo kudá madák abe una kaí, nuka kal kei atin afan aka Got ami Mane kalumo.
Aka Got aket kudawsa. Ade aka bako, ‘naka Got Mano.’ Kalesa. Kale dabadáluwo afan Got ayo kail bá takeikudawomane.’ Kalumo.” Kalsiw.
Alo weng alataw be ki yakot wanin kinim as dim sil biki alam wol fewa im tam gisiw iliso atam liwin weng bakamsiw.
Yesus fikalesa umi sung uta ko.
Atan gubudim bikida kalo kutamo taden bidák atan sinik alewbino dim unsa be anang bakan adikum uyo midilukin tadu midila bisu ko.
Kale atan sinik alewbino dim tadune, Yesus aka weng dukum kuw bako, ‘Elowai Elowai lama sabaktanai.’ Kalesa. Kale umi mit be, ‘nalam Got, nalam Got watawo kale ibik dunabáwe?’ Kalesa ko.
Kal bom keimane kinim madik tod bidiw iyo kalin weng be kidi nadiwade ika bakodiw, “aka Ilaitsa gánlawbano.” Kalsiw ko.
Wabising kinim mak aka aik yak abum mak takadu kudew tad nadale kudew dák wok wain atud kalbiw kudakabi nadale kutow as gang tem tade kufo kudew tam Yesus dádawi, wanako, kale kanamsa.
Beta madik tod bidiw iyo bako nadiwade, “yei kano dabadálawo asuduw, Ilaitsa so madák kail bá takeikudawomane, kalumo.” Kal bom keimiwe,
beta Yesus ayo weng dukum bako, “kolo” kalbane mam dakang sinik tamánsu.
Kale be kano kei badale ilim kal Yol am awsom atimin uyo kikiw kuw kádat tam maung dakat, dák maung dakat keidune, bakan uyo wok falil bakan kei budu, tum uyo bakel bakel budu,
fom lung uyo kádat bisudune, yak kanomin kinim kidel kidel imi dam fikalesiw iyo talá tabesiw.
Kale Yesus ayo fikale talá tabane kawákal wanang kinim fom lung kalo talá tabesidiw iyo yak Yedusalem abiw abem dukum uniwe, wanang kinim seng iyo itamámsiw ko.

Kale un tabudin gebom mak keidane, un tabudin kinim keidiw iyo bim sone ufek ufek adikum kanodu so uyo utam fingánin dukum kei bom nadiwade bako kaliw, “kuina, atin afan aka Got Man tutun be.” Kalesiw.
Kale wanang seng seng iyo un bi yak sikam kaek kal tod nadiwe kin mobisiw bidi, Galili bakan kal Yesus so yán abo ká bom nadiwo wol kin modaw tadanusiw ita.
Kale bidi Madiya umi abiw Makdala, wáw Madiya Yemis so Yoses akun ade Sebeddi ami muduw akun keidu, ita wanang kanomin im wol bake kámámsiw ko.
Yesus dausiw umi sung uta ko.
Kale bi am kuin kuin tadale Adamatiya kinim kisol so win tabin mak be. Ami win ayo Yosew aka Yesus dang tein kámin kinimo, kale
aka tam Bailet atam nadale bakodaw, “nata Yesus fom fakadulono.” Akane, aka kalo weng dauyam yak Yesus dam uyo kudawino. Yakane, kudawiwe,
Yosew ayo Yesus atukul uyo kudu nadale ilim kidelok mak umi win linen kalbiw ata falala dau nadale
dew yak alam tum tem alokso fuko dabadása kal dau nadale tum dukum mak budun budun faku kudew maek tum tem abiw dalo awsom ati kudá una.
Madiya Makdala kayak keidu Madiya kukum mak keidu alew ita tum tem alam tuduno kaekal tein bom kin mobisiw ko.
Un tabudin kinim tum tem kin mo dumobisiw sung uta ko.
Kale am mak dánokaba be ban dukámin am dánokabano kale bom tuma asa kei bidiw sidiwo matam bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim keidiwe, Fedasi keidiw iyo tad Bailet atam nadiwade
ika bakodiw, “kawta, nulum kal ko, Yesus aka kaunsin alom nadale ibakamin weng mak bako nadale, ‘naka am alewbino kei nadile asiki talá tabokabino.” Kalesa.

Kale kaba wenga be mak dauyamaw kinim be mak yak bom nadiwo tum tem yal be kit kit kale bom kin mo sidiw si am alewbino be banimak kala, masi alam weng kidimin kinim aso tad nadiwade atukul uyo yakot wane kuwá nadiwade kinim wanang bakoyam bána talá tabese.” Kaloliw kala, “kanamom masi ibakamin weng ayo kamakikiw kanamámsiw akamam matam mafak seng so mak keidomu kala.” Akiwe,
Bailet ayo weng kala bakoyam, “yak un tabudin mak imadew yak dádiw tum tem kit kit dumo todin kala.” Yakane,
ika afan yak tum tem fal káw káw neda dau nadiwe un tabudin iyo dumo kin mobisiw ko.
